VERDICT: CLEAN

BOUNDARY: Checked that $0,1\in S$ (so $\varphi(0),\varphi(1)\in\varphi[S]$), that $S\cap J_i$ can be empty or a singleton without breaking the diameter bound, that $J=[0,\varphi(1)]$ is non‑degenerate ($\varphi(1)>0$), that the Archimedean property supplies $N$ with $1/(2\iota(N))\le\varepsilon$, and that oriented integrals handle any ordering of limits. All edge cases are correctly treated or not applicable.

SOURCES: Inspected every citation listed in the item’s `deps` and used in the proof—including the definitions of the fat Cantor set, measure/content zero, the Lebesgue criterion, the FTC, and all order‑field and sum facts—against the exact current text supplied in the dispatch. Every cited item matches its required hypotheses, domain, and conclusion, and supports the argument as claimed.

CHECKED: Verified the title, the public false claim, and the counterexample construction. Examined every numbered proof step (1.1–12.1) together with the Remarks. The witness is valid, the reasoning is correct, and the refutation fatally undermines the purported weakening of the substitution theorem.
